name: lcstacks
description: The per-pid kernel stacks must really live in language-card RAM ($00:E000+), not merely appear to. A green suite is consistent with a config change that silently failed to take, so this counts the $C5C5 canary Task_AllocKernStack seeds: at least one page carrying it in the language card, and ZERO in the vacated $0C00 region. Reading the vacated region is the half that a passing suite would otherwise hide. It is deliberately not asserted to be empty -- it holds stage-2 boot residue, which is expected and unrelated.
